Reproduction: Enter either provided test-account email and submit Send reset link.
Expected: Show a success or clear error result; deliver the reset email.
Actual: The submit button remained on Please wait for more than 20 seconds; no confirmation appeared. User confirmed neither test inbox received a reset email.
Result: Failed; reproduced for both test accounts
Notes: Reset-link arrival and token completion could not be verified.

Reproduction: Search Madhapur Hyderabad and select the first suggestion.
Expected: City is Hyderabad; Area is Madhapur.
Actual: City is Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation West Zone; Area is Madhapur Hyderabad India.
Notes: Can save incorrect location data and affect matching.

Reproduction: Reload a conversation that already has messages.
Expected: Show a loading state until the conversation detail response arrives.
Actual: No messages yet briefly appears while existing messages are loading; messages then appear after about two seconds.
Notes: Messages eventually loaded and were not lost.

Reproduction: Sign in with either newly created test account.
Expected: Complete sign-in promptly and provide clear progress feedback.
Actual: The UI stayed on Please wait for several seconds before redirecting; both logins eventually succeeded.
Notes: Possible cold-start latency; exact duration was not measured with a performance harness.

Reproduction: Open public auth pages while signed out.
Expected: Public screens render without unexpected browser errors.
Actual: A failed-resource 401 appeared in browser events; the auth screens remained usable.
Notes: Likely related to unauthenticated session checking; not established as a user-facing defect.

Reproduction: Create both requested accounts, then sign in to each.
Expected: Accounts can be created and authenticated.
Actual: Both accounts were created and both subsequent logins succeeded.
Notes: No email verification was required during signup.

Reproduction: Save synthetic QA profile details and matching preferences for both accounts.
Expected: Saved values persist and success feedback is shown.
Actual: Both profile and preference updates succeeded.

Reproduction: User One sends a connection request to User Two; User Two accepts.
Expected: Request appears for the recipient and accepted connection is visible to both.
Actual: Request was received and accepted; both accounts showed the connection.

Reproduction: Send a message from each test account to the other, then reload.
Expected: Both messages appear in the conversation and persist.
Actual: Both messages appeared on both sides and persisted after reload.
Notes: Transient false-empty-state issue is tracked as BUG-03.

Reproduction: User Two creates a group; User One requests to join; User Two approves.
Expected: Owner can review the request; membership updates for both users.
Actual: Request was approved; both users saw the group at 2/3 members.

Route: Home / Matches / Connections / Groups / Messages / Preferences / Profile
Expected: No horizontal overflow; text and controls remain usable.
Actual: No horizontal overflow observed on the checked routes.
Notes: Production desktop and mobile smoke coverage.

Reproduction: Open Matches while signed in after production auth-proxy changes.
Actual: Matches loaded for both test users; prior Authentication required issue did not recur.

Reproduction: Two user accounts, profiles/preferences, accepted connection, conversation/messages, and QA group were created for testing.
Expected: Test data is identified and not confused with real users.
Actual: QA records remain in production; no cleanup/deletion was performed.
Notes: No temporary passwords are included in this sheet.

Reproduction: Search for Madhapur Hyderabad and select the Madhapur suggestion.
Expected: City is Hyderabad; Area is Madhapur.
Actual: Destination City populated as Greater Hyderabad Municipal Corporation West Zone; Area as Madhapur.
Notes: No Save clicked; reload restored the persisted values.

Reproduction: Navigate to Messages with an existing QA conversation and monitor the initial load.
Expected: Keep a loading state until message data arrives; show saved messages without a false empty state.
Actual: The message area stayed blank during the first ~300 ms; both persisted QA messages rendered by ~700 ms; 'No messages yet' was not shown.
Notes: No new message sent; existing messages remained visible.

Route: Home / Matches / Connections / Messages / Groups / Preferences / Profile
Reproduction: Open each route as a QA account at desktop and mobile widths; open a match detail and refresh the dashboard.
Expected: All routes render authenticated data without horizontal overflow.
Actual: Each route loaded; no horizontal overflow at tested widths. Match detail and dashboard refresh worked.
Notes: Read-only smoke run. Profile/preferences were not saved; connection/group/chat actions were not submitted.

Reproduction: Submit empty login and forgot-password forms; inspect the signup form.
Expected: Public screens render and required-field validation blocks incomplete submissions.
Actual: Login, signup and reset forms rendered; empty sign-in/reset were blocked by required fields.
Notes: No credentials or reset emails submitted.
